steps.do: As Test MktExec, look for Delete on the register.
steps.observed: No Delete on the register for Test MktExec.

steps.do: As Master Admin, press Delete on the enquiry WITH a quotation.
steps.expect: Refused: "A quote has been raised against INQ-…, so it is part of the record and cannot be deleted. Set its status to Dropped instead."
steps.observed: Delete is not offered on the quoted enquiry; forcing it is refused: "A quote has been raised against INQ-00001, so it is part of the record and cannot be deleted. It follows that quotation; mark the quotation lost if the work is not coming." — since 12–13 Nov 2026 an enquiry follows its quotation (Won / Lost by itself; Dropped only with a reason, and not once quoted), so the advice is no longer "Set its status to Dropped".
steps.note: The register does not draw Delete on an enquiry that has a quotation (status Quoted); the robot forced the delete request to see the refusal.
steps.suggest: As Master Admin: an enquiry WITH a quotation offers no Delete. (If forced: "A quote has been raised against INQ-…, so it is part of the record and cannot be deleted. It follows that quotation; mark the quotation lost if the work is not coming.")

steps.do: Delete the one without a quotation.
steps.expect: "Inquiry INQ-… deleted." and an activity entry is written.
